mechanism.summary: LEAD-APPROVED FREEZE (plan-feedback-1, 2026-10-21); no K1 implementation or timing screen is started by this handoff. One three-stage successor K -> A -> B; fixed base M=9eba7a1d6ae8b67397d20e0d6c93ac79037f5e30 for every cumulative stage/formal decision, including K cost. Stage 1 K (T064) cold-outlines object-bearing typed arms for both Vm and WideLoopFrame along the reviewed spike boundary; no crate, FFI or recipe change. Static gate scripts/check-kernel-isolation.sh (delivered separately on agent/t064-k0-checker/codex) must enforce T064's lead-decision contract: identical instruction boundaries/intra-function relative PCs, non-address bytes, owned table bytes/targets/relative positions and stack layout; identical RIP referent widths and non-pointer bytes. Pointer-sized slots inside referents compare relocated target identity (section, symbol or import, offset within symbol) and target contents under the same rule, not raw pointer values, under the lead-feedback-1 amendment in tasks/T064-kernel-isolation.md#lead-decision-2026-10-21; cite that contract, not a checker commit. Unknown/unresolvable or partial slots fail closed; non-pointer bytes and owned tables remain protected. Classify/report displacement-only RIP and call/import fixups as allowed; unknown decoding/relocation, missing/duplicate/cloned roles and ineffective perturbations fail closed. Full A/A/H+8/C+8 qualification for K, targeted actual-candidate perturbations before A/B, full matrix on kernel/ABI/toolchain/recipe changes. Stage 2 A (T056) makes owned bounded transitions/layouts the authority for all ordinary named stores, replacing Dynamic's name map and ObjectLiteralShape.lookup in the same stage, one probe per add and one layout pointer, ObjectData <=120 bytes, per docs/design/property-layouts.md and T056 work-count tests. Stage 3 B routes ordinary/shared accelerated Get/Set through atoms/layouts and retires rejecting probes/redundant revisions. Do not automatically port 5dd3a810's 112-byte diagnostic shape; justify header/batch/key edits from fresh inputs. After K integrates at I, exact I profiles must reconfirm M1 reach before A; changed priority/scope stops for new review without retargeting or budget reset. I->A attribution is supplemental only. Every acceptance candidate is M plus reviewed K/M1 runtime commits, with tooling/docs merges allowed; record git diff M <candidate> -- crates before every screen and stop for unrelated runtime changes. FAILURE LEDGER: original interpreter-core-v2-layout-edges plan SHA-256 d184dbcc122a060a219b367ffe3f3bb02c216f542f75f51eee1925387ef23284 and failed candidate 0a9af81bebcef80e9239954f8db191a71f10316e remain permanent. That valid K=6 failure spent 1/2 of old A+B; exactly ONE unused A+B failure transfers, shared across successor stages 2 and 3. Successor stage 1 K has at most ONE independent failed screen, with no transfer/borrowing to A+B; a valid K failure immediately stops isolation and sends the lead to M2. Successor aggregate max_attempts=2 is only an upper bound, never permission to continue after K failure. No new successor failure has been spent. Stage aborts count; incomplete evidence follows existing completion rules and replenishes nothing; static/correctness/pre-gate failures stop before timing without spending a timing attempt. Validate-unit does not enforce these manual per-stage ledger caps. GATES: before every timed screen, exact M/candidate images run once per role on all 86 policy cases for instructions; a ratio above max(1.03,I_i) blocks timing, all pre-gates recorded, and the screen uses the exact image that passed. K and A require cumulative neutrality at min(B_i,1.025) on every case with unchanged instruction/lane/portfolio ceilings, complete 5-pair K=6, then cumulative formal advance. Explicitly audit this stricter cap on diagnostic-only cases where the schema stage evaluator uses 1.025 alone. All stages are instruction-blind, with memory wall targets equal to final targets, 60 formal blocks, mandatory replayed complete resource report/raw for exact M/candidate and host, and existing v6 continuation/precision/load rules. MANUAL RESOURCE CEILING (lead decision 2026-10-21): for every target and every development case (11 distinct cases), require per-process max RSS candidate/M <=1.05, using the median of the paired per-process max-RSS candidate/M ratios over the complete formal run resource sample cohort for that case. Bind the case-level resource samples to the formal run, exact candidate/M images, host and block identities; missing case coverage or samples blocks a stage decision. Existing generic resource-probe evidence alone does not cover these cases. Exceeding 1.05 blocks advance/promotion pending lead review. Tooling does not enforce this numerical ceiling or per-case cohort coverage; record the ratios, sample coverage and manual verdict before every stage decision, alongside mandatory replayed resource report/raw completeness. Do not use instructions or aggregate RSS to waive a case excess. Record services, projections/publications, moved bytes, allocation counts and scratch high-water/retention; numeric-only loops have zero per-iteration services/allocations. Full correctness/NG/curated subset/exact configured Test262 zero gap and static gates precede advancing a stage. Only final B may retain, with per-target min(.97,1/B_i), every pair improving, natural and required six-layout aggregate, all controls/lanes, resources and 30-pair held-out acceptance with mandatory K=6 event/diagnostic completion. No held-out selection. This freeze spends no screen/formal attempt and enacts the old layout-edges continuation as closed-superseded; its final performance standing remains unresolved. Keep its JSON/failed result unchanged and fabricate no decide outcome. The closure is recorded in tasks/archive/T064-layout-edges-closure.md; the lead decision and manual checks are in tasks/proposals/T064-successor-review.md. No prior stage-A measurement was used to choose these targets; diff/compare is a control.
mechanism.generality: Admission is ordinary named-property semantics, receiver kind, atom domain/layout identity and numeric versus object-bearing typed operations. No source/bytecode-template, property-spelling, benchmark/library identity, checksum, path or iteration-count admission. Preserve slot-indexed locals and shared upvalue cells; no per-call name-keyed snapshot, new crate/dependency, FFI, unsafe or recipe/CPU policy change.
semantic_risks: Cold outlining must retain scalar widths/alignment, admission/tier reach, NaN/minus-zero/coercion order, residency and exact deopt PC/stack/publication. Services execute once; release borrows before observers/throws and reacquire afterward.

Layout/descriptor/enumeration and delete-reinsert order remain correct across Small/Dynamic/Shaped/dictionary encodings, equal keys with different attributes, lazy properties, seal/freeze, class fields, constructor substitution and keys beyond 32/128 properties.

Computed keys perform ToPropertyKey once. Atom domains remain realm-correct under eval/with, cross-realm/native/host/null-prototype inputs and escaping values; canonical/surrogate key equality is preserved.

Bound transition/shape/atom retention under churn; dictionaries keep independent identity/version, stable ordered slots and tombstone compaction. Never retain duplicate lookup authority or re-link/create a domain per store.
Proxy/accessor/callback/native re-entry and TypedArray detachment preserve observable order and shared-cell/TDZ authority; object/layout borrows cannot survive re-entry.

Static artifact equality is not speed or placement immunity. Boundary calls, spills, startup, allocations and scratch transport remain priced against M on the full v6 portfolio. Resource completeness alone cannot waive the manual per-case median max-RSS candidate/M ceiling of 1.05 for all targets and development cases; exceeding it blocks advance/promotion pending lead review.
